description: Helsingin Seudun Liikenteen (HSL) joukkoliikenteen risteyssolmut is a dataset listed in Open Data Finland, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Helsingin seudun liikenne (HSL). Helsinki Region Transport's (HSL) public transport knots. Data attributes and preview in HSL's website. Coverage: Helsingin seudun liikenne (HSL). The publisher named on the listing is Helsingin seudun liikenne (HSL). Its keywords include linja-autoliikenne, bus traffic, joukkoliikenne, public transport, risteyssolmut, crossings. The listing shows 5 download or service links in SHP, CSV, GEOJSON, KML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source.
